HJ중공업이 HD현대 아비커스와 손잡고 자율 운항 선박 시장 공략에 나선다. 인공지능(AI) 기반 자율 운항 기술을 선박에 적용해 미래 고부가가치 선박 시장 선점에 속도를 낸다는 전략이다.

HJ중공업은 HD현대의 선박 자율 운항 솔루션 전문 자회사인 HD현대 아비커스와 자율 운항 솔루션 공급 및 기술협력을 위한 양해각서(MOU)를 체결했다고 8일 밝혔다.

협약식은 지난 4일 그리스 아테네 메트로폴리탄 엑스포센터에서 열린 세계 최대 규모 해양산업 전시회인 포시도니아(Posidonia) 현장에서 진행됐다. 행사에는 HJ중공업 유상철 대표와 HD현대 아비커스 강재호 대표가 참석했다.

핵심이슈.summary:
## 오늘의 한국 경제 흐름 요약

달러-원 환율이 1,550원을 돌파하며 외환시장 불안이 고조되는 가운데, 당국의 대규모 실개입이 쉽지 않다는 분석이 나오면서 원화 약세 압력이 지속될 것으로 전망된다. 대외적으로는 미국 증시가 금리 부담과 대형 IPO 영향으로 급락했으나, 전문가들은 펀더멘털이 견고하다며 단기 조정 국면으로 평가해 글로벌 불확실성이 국내 시장에도 영향을 미치고 있다. 국내 신용 측면에서는 '생산적 금융' 기조 아래 1분기 전 산업 대출금이 14분기 만에 최대 폭으로 증가하며 자금 흐름이 활발해지는 모습이다. 한편 이재명 대통령은 부동산 투기 근절을 강조하며 세제·금융 분야의 추가 대책을 예고해, 부동산 시장을 겨냥한 정책 강화가 금융·대출 환경에도 파급 효과를 미칠 것으로 주목된다. 결국 오늘 경제 흐름은 **환율 불안, 글로벌 금리 부담, 신용 팽창, 부동산 규제 강화**라는 네 가지 축이 복합적으로 맞물린 하루였다.

key_headlines.title: Semiconductor Exports Surge 182% Amid Economic Recovery, but Middle East Risks Persist
key_headlines.summary: Korea Development Institute reports continued moderate economic improvement driven by semiconductor-led exports and investment growth. However, construction sector weakness, employment slowdown, and inflationary pressures remain concerns.

key_headlines.title: KOSPI Collapses to 7,400 on 'Black Monday' Amid US Semiconductor Shock and Currency Crisis
key_headlines.summary: South Korean stock market plummeted 8.3% with circuit breaker triggered, as US semiconductor stocks crashed and won-dollar exchange rate exceeded 1,555 won amid global financial turmoil. KOSDAQ also fell 9%.

key_headlines.title: Government and Bank of Korea Vow Strong Response to Excessive Won Depreciation
key_headlines.summary: Finance ministry and central bank officials announced they will not tolerate excessive volatility and one-way currency movements, signaling strong intervention to stabilize the won-dollar exchange rate.

key_headlines.title: President Lee Redefines Jeonse Housing Market as Normalization Process, Promises Additional Real Estate Measures
key_headlines.summary: President Lee characterized the declining jeonse (lease deposit) market as a natural normalization of Korea's unique semi-financial system, stating previous excessive lending fueled house prices and fraud.

key_headlines.title: Global Bond Markets Turbulent as Fed Rate Hike Expectations Rise Amid Inflation Fears
key_headlines.summary: US 2-year Treasury yields hit 16-month highs as markets expect central banks globally to raise rates to combat inflation triggered by Iran-related oil price shocks.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy continues moderate recovery momentum driven by semiconductor-led exports growing 182% and robust investment, according to the Korea Development Institute's June economic report. However, the nation faces simultaneous challenges including construction sector weakness, employment slowdown, and accelerating inflation pressures. On June 8, the KOSPI experienced a severe "Black Monday" decline of 8.3% and triggered circuit breaker mechanisms, driven by US semiconductor stock crashes and won-dollar exchange rates exceeding 1,555 won. The government and Bank of Korea have signaled strong intervention to stabilize currency markets and prevent excessive volatility.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: South Korea's Q1 GDP growth reached 1.7%, ranking second in the OECD after Denmark and marking dramatic recovery from -0.2% in Q4 last year. Industrial lending for productive purposes surged to the largest increase in 14 quarters during Q1. However, fiscal deficit concerns persist with youth employment rates declining for 24 consecutive months, prompting government assertions that the semiconductor boom is expanding GDP and maintaining favorable fiscal health relative to other major economies. Japan's Q1 real GDP growth remained steady at 0.5%, recording consecutive quarterly growth, while April current account surplus surged 64.9%.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSPI crashed to 7,484.41 on June 8, down 8.29% due to concerns about US Federal Reserve rate hikes, semiconductor sector weakness, and geopolitical risks. Circuit breakers and sell-side circuit locks were triggered, with the KOSDAQ falling 9% simultaneously. Global bond markets experienced significant turbulence as US 2-year Treasury yields reached 16-month highs, reflecting expectations of interest rate increases across major central banks to combat inflation. Despite the sharp decline, individual investors net-purchased 1.76 trillion won while foreign investors sold 355.7 billion won, with some analysts suggesting the correction may create buying opportunities given solid corporate fundamentals.
sections.Industry & Technology: South Korea's semiconductor exports reached record highs with memory semiconductor exports accounting for 31.9 billion dollars in April alone, driving total monthly exports to 85.89 billion dollars. The government approved 10 regulatory reforms requested by business groups, including relaxing height restrictions for semiconductor factories and enabling apartment parking robots. Major Korean conglomerates including SK Telecom, Doosan, and LG announced strategic partnerships with Nvidia to develop gigawatt-scale AI data centers and advance physical AI and mobility solutions.
sections.Real Estate: President Lee's administration implemented housing policies focused on demand suppression and owner-occupancy through tightened lending regulations and comprehensive tax reforms over the past year, successfully moderating apartment price increases while stabilizing the market. However, jeonse (lease deposit) prices surged due to dwindling supply, prompting the president to characterize this as a normalization process of Korea's unique semi-financial system and to blame previous excessive lending as the primary driver of house price inflation. Dongtan in Gyeonggi Province recorded the nation's highest apartment price growth rate at 0.60% weekly, drawing attention for potential additional government regulation, while Yeouido is accelerating apartment redevelopment projects with multiple complexes advancing reconstruction plans.
sections.International Economy: Global financial markets face significant uncertainty ahead of the Federal Reserve's first policy meeting under new Chair Kevin Wash on June 16-17, with President Trump publicly pressuring the Fed to cut interest rates rather than raise them. Markets are currently pricing in either rate holds or modest increases as inflation concerns persist following Iran-related oil price shocks, with US 2-year Treasury yields reaching 16-month highs. The divergence between Trump's demands for lower rates and market expectations for higher rates has created confusion about the Fed's future policy direction and economic management.
sections.AI & Economy: Bank of Korea analysis reveals that while generative AI reduces work hours by approximately 1.5 hours per 40-hour work week, there is no correlation between time savings and actual productivity improvements, suggesting AI enhances individual task efficiency but has not translated into broader organizational workflow improvements or productivity gains. Major Korean companies including SK Telecom, Doosan, LG, and Hyundai Motor have announced comprehensive strategic alliances with Nvidia to develop AI infrastructure, physical AI robots, and autonomous mobility solutions, positioning Korea as a regional leader in next-generation AI industries. AI-focused data center investments accelerated with Coraumco and DCI commencing a 40MW AI data center project in Ansan's industrial complex.
sections.Others: Han Korea Investment Trust's US Space Tech Active ETF surged in popularity with individual investors net-purchasing over 600 billion won in the past month following SpaceX's anticipated IPO announcement. Concrete mixer truck unions representing 10,000 vehicles in the Seoul metropolitan area initiated strikes due to construction industry downturn and prolonged revenue loss, though prolonged labor actions are expected to be limited by drivers' income concerns. LG-affiliated Polyphenol Factory launched Gravity PDRN hair care products based on microalgae technology developed with KAIST, targeting domestic and global K-beauty markets amid broader excellence in cosmetics exports.
